svg.title: AI engineering factory — master execution diagram
svg.desc: All twelve configured steps, five human decisions, two bounded review stages, read-only investigation, admission routes, four lifecycle hooks, data bindings, artifacts, and terminal outcomes.

g.text: python3 ./scripts/git-worktree.py · base HEAD → isolated execution worktree

g.title: intake — task_intake · agents/task_intake
g.text: Select a task type; populate its template without inventing facts.
Preserve the request, source references, scope and unknowns.

g.title: check-readiness — readiness · classifiers/task-readiness
g.text: Validate typed task and original source; assess type and readiness.
Emit the original evaluation request and validated response.
Task structure and original source must validate.
Otherwise → human admission in the selected route.
Root cause and complete designs are not intake prerequisites.

g.title: admission-review — Change-task admission
g.text: Record context in the decision reason.

g.title: investigation-admission — Read-only admission
g.text: Keep read-only scope; resubmit to change task type.
Limit exhaustion escalates findings; it does not approve work.

g.title: specification — architect · agents/architect
g.text: Define behavior, constraints and acceptance criteria.
Develop a proportional design and verification plan.

g.title: architecture_review — architecture_reviewer
g.text: Review spec and plan against the task and project.
Record stable finding IDs and reviewed revisions.

g.title: design_approval — Review artifacts: spec.html · plan.html
g.text: Approve implementation or return design feedback.
git-commit.py · docs(design): record project changes from approved design
Limit exhaustion escalates findings; it does not approve work.

g.title: build — implementer · agents/coder_golang
g.text: Implement the approved spec and plan.
Record commands, results, changed files and limitations.

g.title: code_review — code_reviewer · agents/code_reviewer_golang
g.text: Track findings, revisions and current verification evidence.

g.title: acceptance — Decision artifacts: none declared in factory.yaml
g.text: Decision artifacts: none declared in factory.yaml
Accept the result or request implementation changes.
Read-only route bypasses design and implementation stages.
Decision reasons remain in execution history.
Agents consume assessments as fallible data.
Clean review reaches its human gate.
Human request_changes returns to the author
Dashed edges show engine limit handling.
Readiness errors fail the attempt; no explicit failed route is set.
Hook failures stop their boundary; after hooks require success.
Documents and review evidence stay outside source commits.
Each route produces only its applicable artifacts.
Human-accepted result; required stage hooks have completed.
python3 ./scripts/git-worktree.py --release · retain workspace + branch · no merge or push
Solid: configured outcome route Dashed: engine loop-limit route Inline red: route to $blocked
